## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasEBookViewer> CreateEBookViewer( const std::string& id, float w = 0, float h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasEBookViewer(const std::string& id, float w = 0, float h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onDocumentLoaded` | `std::function<void(const EBookMetadata&)> onDocumentLoaded` | _Document loaded_ |
| `onChapterChanged` | `std::function<void(int chapterIndex, const std::string& title)> onChapterChanged` | _Chapter changed_ |
| `onZoomChanged` | `std::function<void(float zoomPercent)> onZoomChanged` | Fired whenever the zoom level changes (argument is the percent, e.g. 125). |
| `onError` | `std::function<void(const std::string& error)> onError` | _Error_ |
| `onLoadProgress` | `std::function<void(float progress, const std::string& status)> onLoadProgress` | _Load progress_ |
| `onExternalLink` | `std::function<void(const std::string& url)> onExternalLink` | Content link with an external scheme (http:, https:, mailto:, ...) was clicked; the viewer only follows links inside the book itself. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
